hypothesis: H483: donna-folded fork preserves behavioural equivalence on >=4 of 5 representative DONNA delegations

equivalence_criterion.description: For each delegation: sign via bin/notarise on upstream HEAD and on the folded path under identical inputs. Compare the resulting IDR record bytes (canonical JSON) and the HMAC-SHA256 signature. Pass = byte-identical match. The 5 form a chain: D02.previous_hash = sha256(D01) and so on.

delegations.label: multi-party intent with cc + deadline
delegations.intent: Send Sarah the M&A precedent we used for Dubrovnik, ask her to redline by Tuesday, copy Marcus when she replies.

delegations.label: single recipient with verb and deadline
delegations.intent: Mike, draft the response brief by Friday.

delegations.label: duration logged against a matter
delegations.intent: Just spent ninety minutes on the Smith motion.

delegations.label: replay a chain segment
delegations.intent: Show me what I delegated this week.

delegations.label: regulator-ready packet
delegations.intent: Export today as a regulator packet.

execution_protocol.step_2: For each delegation D01..D05 in order, call bin/notarise sign with intent + fixed timestamp + fixed signer + fixed confidence + computed previous_hash
execution_protocol.step_3: Capture the canonical JSON output + signature for each
execution_protocol.step_4: Compare upstream output vs folded output byte-by-byte for each of the 5
execution_protocol.step_5: Tally matches. >=4 -> H483 confirmed. <=3 -> H483 falsified.
execution_protocol.step_6: Emit a single JSON line per delegation to data/fold-measurements.jsonl with {id, primitive, upstream_sig, folded_sig, match}

anti_goodhart_notes.why_each_primitive_matters: Picking 5 variations of the same verb would fail to exercise routing across DONNA's surface. One-per-verb forces the fold to preserve all five code paths.
anti_goodhart_notes.why_sha256_match: Semantic equivalence is judgable; signature match is computable. The test cannot drift to pass while the underlying logic differs.
anti_goodhart_notes.why_fixed_inputs: Timestamps, decision_ids, and previous_hashes are non-deterministic in production. Fixing them is what makes byte-equivalent comparison possible. The test measures the fold's correctness, not DONNA's runtime randomness.
anti_goodhart_notes.what_could_still_go_wrong: If bin/notarise produces different output under different Python versions (e.g. dict ordering, locale-aware string handling), the test fails for reasons unrelated to the fold. Mitigation: pin Python 3.10+ in both environments and use canonical JSON serialisation.
